description: Source code for the 'jsoniter' package, implementing custom JSON number parsing and conversion methods for big.Float, big.Int, float32, and float64.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A struct providing methods to parse JSON numbers into various numeric types.

methods.name: ReadFloat32

methods.name: ReadFloat64
methods.description: Reads a JSON number and converts it to a float64.
